postings.title: General Application (UK)
postings.description:
ABOUT ISEMBARD

Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies, with factories across the UK, US, Germany and France. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration.


DON'T SEE THE RIGHT ROLE?

We often meet great people before we have the right opening for them. If you want to help build Isembard in the UK and none of our live roles there fits, apply here and tell us what you'd want to work on.

We read every application. When a role opens that matches your experience, we'll get in touch.


WHO WE'D LIKE TO HEAR FROM

 - Machinists, programmers, inspectors and engineers who have made precision parts.

 - Software, robotics and data people who want their work to run on a real factory floor.

 - Operations, supply chain, commercial and finance people who can help a fast-growing manufacturer scale.


HOW TO APPLY

 - Upload your CV and add your LinkedIn profile if you have one.

 - Tell us which area interests you.

 - A few lines on why Isembard is plenty. No cover letter needed.

Location: On-site at our London factory.

Isembard is an equal opportunity employer.

postings.title: CAM Programmer
postings.description:
ABOUT ISEMBARD

Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies, with factories across the UK, US, Germany and France. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration.


THE ROLE

CAM programming connects the drawing to repeatable precision production. Our central CAM team in London programmes parts for factories across the network, and how many new parts we can take on depends on it.

You will own programming and machining standards from toolpath to prove-out, support complex parts, and write the methods and libraries other sites reuse.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Programme, simulate and optimise 3-axis and 5-axis milling.

 - Prove out first articles to aerospace and defence standards.

 - Choose tooling, cutting parameters and work-holding for aluminium, steels, titanium and Inconel.

 - Drive cycle time and machine utilisation.

 - Standardise programmes across our UK factories, and maintain toolpath libraries, templates and documentation.

 - Support complex part programming and train machinists at local sites.

 - Send DFM feedback to customers as new parts move from drawing to production.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong CAM programming in Hypermill (preferred), Mastercam, Siemens NX or equivalent.

 - A record of holding ±0.01 mm or tighter.

 - Experience setting and running high-end machines in production, such as Hermle or DMG Mori, across a multi-machine environment.

 - A solid understanding of feeds, speeds, tooling strategy and work-holding, based on reasoning rather than habit.

 - Confident interpretation of complex drawings and GD&T.

 - Clean documentation and revision control, so someone else can pick up your programme a year from now.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Aerospace or defence manufacturing experience.

 - 5-axis simultaneous machining.

 - Titanium and high-strength alloys.

 - NC simulation such as Vericut, and probing or pallet systems.

 - EN 9100 or AS9100 familiarity.


WHY ISEMBARD

 - Set programming standards the whole network reuses.

 - Work on advanced machine tools on parts that matter.

 - Competitive salary and equity.

Location: On-site at our Southwark factory in London, with visits to other UK sites. This is a hands-on factory role: you programme it, prove it and help run it.

postings.title: Software Engineer
postings.description:
ABOUT ISEMBARD

Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies, with factories across the UK, US, Germany and France. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration.


THE ROLE

MasonOS coordinates our factory network across four countries. This role builds the part of it that makes decisions: which site takes an order, which supplier fills a gap, how the schedule changes when a machine goes down.

It is backend engineering with physical consequences. When the routing is wrong, metal sits still.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build order routing across the sites in our network.

 - Build supplier orchestration and the data behind it.

 - Design backend architecture for more sites than we run today, not just the ones we have.

 - Deploy MasonOS into new sites as the network grows, and adapt your abstractions when they meet a real shop floor.

 - Set and defend the reliability standards for a system that production depends on.

 - Work closely with our factory and robotics teams.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals.

 - Real experience with distributed systems.

 - Good judgement about failure: what is allowed to degrade, and what must never break.

 - Comfort working in high-security environments.

 - Typically three or more years of professional experience, though we will consider exceptional early-career engineers who can add value quickly.

 - A willingness to learn how a factory runs from the people who run it. You do not need a manufacturing background, but you should want one.


WHY ISEMBARD

 - Work on systems that control physical production, with results you can see on the shop floor.

 - High ownership and real influence over the architecture.

 - Competitive salary and equity.

Location: On-site at our Southwark factory in London, with travel to new sites when deploying MasonOS.

postings.title: CNC Machinist
postings.description:
ABOUT ISEMBARD

Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defense, energy and frontier technology companies, with factories across the US, UK, Germany and France. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration.


THE ROLE

The parts you cut go into aircraft, defense systems, energy infrastructure and robots. This is a hands-on machining role at our Dallas factory, where you own your work from the program to the finished part rather than handing it down a line.

The factory is still being shaped, so you will help improve the setup rather than wait for it.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Program, simulate and optimize toolpaths in 3-axis, 5-axis and mill-turn where it applies.

 - Set up, prove out and run jobs to aerospace and defense standards.

 - Own cycle time and machine utilization.

 - Choose fixturing, tooling and cutting parameters for aluminum, steels, titanium and Inconel.

 - Take new parts from drawing to repeatable production, with DFM feedback for the customer.

 - Log your work accurately in MasonOS, our in-house operating software.

 - Help standardize programming approaches that other sites in the network can reuse.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong CAM programming in Fusion, Hypermill, Mastercam or equivalent.

 - A record of holding tolerances of ±0.01 mm (about ±0.0004 in) or tighter.

 - Production experience setting and running high-end machines such as Hermle, DMG Mori or Mazak.

 - A solid understanding of feeds, speeds, tooling strategy and workholding.

 - Confident reading of complex drawings and GD&T.

 - Comfort working in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Aerospace, defense or other high-specification experience.

 - 5-axis simultaneous machining.

 - Probing, automation or pallet systems.

 - AS9100 or ISO 9001 familiarity.

 - An interest in robotics and data-driven manufacturing.


WHY ISEMBARD

 - Work on mission-critical aerospace and defense components on advanced machine tools.

 - Influence the programming standards used across our sites.

 - Competitive salary and equity.

 - Medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) with company match, paid time off and parental leave, Wellhub gym and wellness membership, and a stocked kitchen at the factory.

Location: On-site at our Dallas-Fort Worth factory in Carrollton, TX.

Eligibility: This role involves access to ITAR-controlled technical data, so you must be a U.S. person (U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, refugee or asylee).

Isembard is an equal opportunity employer.

THE ROLE

Business development at Isembard is where the customer is an engineer and the pitch is a tolerance. You will open conversations with engineering-led companies in aerospace, defence, energy and robotics, qualify the work, and bring it to the factory teams who make it.

This is our first senior business development representative role, and the BDRs who join later will build on the approach you help set.

 - An engineering background (mechanical preferred) or strong technical literacy.

postings.title: Export Control Officer
postings.description:
ABOUT ISEMBARD

Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies, with factories across the UK, US, Germany and France. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration.


THE ROLE

Isembard makes precision parts for aerospace and defence customers from factories across the UK, US, Germany and France. Goods, software and technical data move between our sites, suppliers and customers, and each transfer has to comply with UK, EU, US and other export-control and sanctions regimes.

The Export Control Officer runs the programme that makes this work and makes sure the people doing the work know what to do. This is our first dedicated export-control hire. The focus is the UK first, with France, Germany and the US to follow, and there is scope to lead the function as it grows.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Run and improve the export-control compliance programme, policies and procedures.

 - Act as the principal point of contact on export control internally and with regulators and customers.

 - Classify goods, software and technical data against the relevant control lists, and keep central records so repeat orders do not need reassessing.

 - Prepare and manage export licences and authorisations, including their conditions and reporting.

 - Operate technology control plans and access controls for controlled technical data.

 - Screen customers, suppliers and other counterparties against restricted-party and sanctions lists.

 - Train people across the business, from machinists and logistics staff to senior leaders.

 - Keep the programme audit-ready, and investigate and fix issues when they arise.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience running an export-control programme in a defence, aerospace or advanced-manufacturing environment.

 - Hands-on UK export licensing experience (SPIRE / LITE) and confident use of the UK military and dual-use lists.

 - Working knowledge of EU dual-use controls, the US ITAR and EAR, and UK, EU and US sanctions regimes.

 - An understanding of deemed-export principles and access controls for foreign persons.

 - Accuracy and attention to detail in classification and record-keeping.

 - The ability to explain complex rules simply, and a pragmatic approach: you explain why and work through the options.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Hands-on ITAR experience, including managing TAAs and MLAs.

 - Experience building an export-control function from scratch.

 - Professional export-control certification. We value experience over formal qualifications.


WHY ISEMBARD

 - Own a function at an early stage and shape how it works.

 - Work closely with engineering, operations, IT security and leadership in a growing manufacturing business.

Location: On-site at our Southwark site in London, with travel to company and customer sites.

Eligibility: This role may require eligibility to access controlled technical data, which can depend on nationality, residency, security-clearance or licensing conditions. The successful candidate must pass pre-employment screening and any applicable export-control or security-clearance requirements.

postings.title: Quality Engineer
postings.description:
ABOUT ISEMBARD

Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies, with factories across the UK, US, Germany and France. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration.


THE ROLE

Quality is where a precision factory earns its customers or loses them. This role owns quality control at our London factory, on parts going to aerospace, defence, energy and other critical industries.

It is hands-on inspection and engineering judgement in equal measure. Beyond the bench, you will build the procedures and controls that let the factory grow without inspection becoming the bottleneck.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Inspect parts entering QC after cleaning, running visual and dimensional checks with the right tooling.

 - Read drawings and part requirements correctly, and disposition rework and nonconforming parts.

 - Keep MasonOS and FlatBOM accurate. The rest of the factory plans against what you record.

 - Build quality procedures and governance so quality is controlled in the process, not only found at final inspection.

 - Improve QC systems and SOPs, and strengthen the handoffs into and out of quality.

 - Drive measurable process improvements with machining and CAM teams.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - An engineering degree or equivalent technical experience.

 - Confidence reading technical drawings.

 - A willingness to work on the factory floor rather than next to it.

 - Problem-solving, initiative and ownership: you will often be the person who notices what others missed.

 - Manufacturing, quality or engineering experience, including from an internship or placement.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Metrology, inspection or QC experience.

 - Process improvement experience.

 - Exposure to precision manufacturing, aerospace, defence or energy.


WHY ISEMBARD

 - Learn quickly across engineering and manufacturing, with one-to-one mentorship.

 - Real room to advance as the quality function grows.

 - Competitive salary and equity.

Location: On-site at our Southwark factory in London.

postings.title: Finance Business Partner

THE ROLE

We are building Isembard's finance function from the ground up, and this role works directly alongside our Finance Director to do it. It is not a traditional business partnering role with settled processes and a large team.

From supplier payments and payroll to month-end, budgeting, cash flow and management reporting, you will run day-to-day finance while building the processes and systems that support our growth. One day you design a payment approval process; the next you run the payment cycle yourself.

 - Support payroll across several countries so people are paid accurately and on time.

 - Set up processes for expenses, reimbursements, supplier onboarding and payment terms.

 - Help manage cash flow, working capital and short-term cash forecasting.

 - Work with the Financial Controller on month-end: accruals, prepayments and reconciliations.

 - Build management reporting, analyse results and explain variances.

 - Partner with manufacturing, operations and commercial teams on budgets, forecasts and production cost analysis.

 - Find manual processes and automate them.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Part-qualified or qualified ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent, or strong relevant finance experience.

 - Experience in management accounting, finance operations, commercial finance or business partnering.

 - A solid grasp of accounting fundamentals and month-end processes, and excellent Excel skills.

 - Comfort moving between operational tasks and analytical, commercial work.

 - Organised and resourceful, with strong communication across teams.

 - A builder's mindset: willing to process invoices as readily as build a model.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Startup or scale-up experience.

 - Manufacturing or another operationally complex environment.

postings.title: Supplier Quality Engineer - London
postings.description:
ABOUT ISEMBARD

Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies, with factories across the UK, US, Germany and France. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration.


THE ROLE

Our parts depend on materials, components and special processes from outside suppliers, and the network can only grow as fast as that supplier base can be trusted.

The Supplier Quality Engineer develops and maintains a capable, aerospace-ready supplier base across Isembard's network, from qualification and risk assessment to performance monitoring and corrective action. It is a central role working with procurement, supply chain, engineering and site quality teams, with the independence to raise concerns and escalate risk without compromising conformity.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead supplier qualification and approval: capability assessments, risk-based audits and approved-supplier recommendations.

 - Define supplier quality requirements, including material certification, conformity documentation, flow-down clauses and special-process approvals.

 - Monitor supplier performance and prioritise improvement by risk.

 - Own supplier nonconformance investigations, containment and corrective action, and check the fix worked.

 - Support receiving and source inspection and first article inspection (AS9102 where applicable).

 - Review supplier changes and guard against counterfeit parts, unauthorised substitutions and lost traceability.

 - Build supplier quality standards and records in our QMS and MasonOS, and support customer and certification audits.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Four or more years in supplier quality, manufacturing quality or quality engineering in precision or regulated production.

 - Working knowledge of AS9100 / EN 9100 or ISO 9001 requirements for external providers, traceability and corrective action.

 - Experience running supplier assessments or audits.

 - Practical root cause analysis and corrective action.

 - Confidence with drawings, specifications, tolerances and certification requirements.

 - Strong documentation and supplier communication, and willingness to travel to suppliers and sites.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Aerospace, defence, CNC machining or high-mix precision manufacturing.

 - NADCAP special processes and raw-material traceability.

 - CMM inspection, GD&T, MSA or SPC.

 - Lead auditor or comparable quality credentials.


WHY ISEMBARD

 - Shape the quality and capability of a growing supplier network.

 - Build quality systems that work in practice, with a direct effect on delivery and customer confidence.

Location: On-site at our Southwark factory in London, with travel to suppliers and Isembard sites.

We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration.


JOIN THE FRANCHISE NETWORK TALENT POOL

Isembard factories are run by owner-operators: people who own and run their own factory on our systems, software and network. As new factories open, they need skilled machinists, setters and programmers.

This is not a single vacancy. Join the pool and we will introduce you to Isembard factories hiring near you, as soon as there is a fit.


WHO WE WOULD LIKE TO HEAR FROM

 - CNC machinists, setters and operators on milling, turning or mill-turn.

 - CAM programmers and people who have proven out parts on the machine.

 - Inspectors comfortable with CMMs and precision measurement.

 - Apprentices and graduates who want to learn on modern 5-axis equipment.


FANCY RUNNING A FACTORY YOURSELF?

Some of the best owner-operators started on the shop floor. If that is you, say so on the form and we will talk you through the franchise route too.

We read every application.

postings.title: Franchise Owner-Operator
postings.description:
This is not a job. It is a factory to build.

Isembard is looking for operators who want to own and run a factory producing precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology. Your business, with our brand, standards, operating playbooks and MasonOS behind it.

It suits two kinds of people: machine-shop owners who want to scale inside a network, and operators who want to build a manufacturing business from the ground up. Location is flexible.


ABOUT ISEMBARD

Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

The business itself, including its economics. You will build and lead a local team and set the standard it works to, hold quality, delivery and customer responsiveness against the network's requirements, own the relationships in your market, and run day-to-day execution on MasonOS. Isembard provides the system; the results are yours.


WHO THIS IS FOR

People who want the responsibility of ownership rather than the title. Manufacturing punishes vagueness: small mistakes become expensive quickly, and slow communication costs trust faster than a missed date does. Prior manufacturing experience matters, particularly if you already run a shop, but judgement, urgency and following through matter more. You should be comfortable being accountable for outcomes you cannot delegate.


WHAT ISEMBARD PROVIDES

Brand and network support, MasonOS, operating playbooks and processes, onboarding and training, and access to experienced manufacturing, operations, software and commercial teams. You bring the ownership. We bring the system.


NOT QUITE READY TO OWN A FACTORY?

Tell us on the form. If the franchise route is not right for now, we can consider you for roles at Isembard instead.

postings.title: Initiativbewerbung, Deutschland (m/w/d)
postings.description:
ÜBER ISEMBARD

Isembard baut ein Netzwerk hochleistungsfähiger Fabriken für kritische Industrien auf. Wir verbinden moderne Werkzeugmaschinen, Robotik und unsere eigene Software MasonOS, um Präzisionsteile für Unternehmen aus Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung, Energie und Zukunftstechnologien zu fertigen, mit Fabriken in Großbritannien, den USA, Deutschland und Frankreich. Unsere Mission: industrielle Beschleunigung schmieden.


KEINE PASSENDE STELLE DABEI?

Wir lernen oft großartige Leute kennen, bevor wir die passende Stelle für sie haben. Wenn du Isembard in Deutschland mit aufbauen willst und keine unserer offenen Stellen passt, bewirb dich hier und erzähl uns, woran du arbeiten möchtest.

Wir lesen jede Bewerbung. Sobald eine Stelle frei wird, die zu deiner Erfahrung passt, melden wir uns.


VON WEM WIR GERN HÖREN

 - Zerspaner, Programmierer, Prüfer und Ingenieure, die schon Präzisionsteile gefertigt haben.

 - Software-, Robotik- und Datenleute, deren Arbeit in einer echten Fertigung laufen soll.

 - Leute aus Operations, Supply Chain, Vertrieb und Finanzen, die einem schnell wachsenden Fertiger beim Skalieren helfen.


SO BEWIRBST DU DICH

 - Lade deinen Lebenslauf hoch und füge dein LinkedIn-Profil hinzu, falls du eins hast.

 - Sag uns, welcher Bereich dich interessiert.

 - Ein paar Zeilen dazu, warum Isembard, reichen völlig. Kein Anschreiben nötig.

Standort: Vor Ort in unserer Fabrik in Hamburg.

Isembard steht für Chancengleichheit. Bewerbungen auf Deutsch oder Englisch sind willkommen.

postings.title: Candidature spontanée, France (H/F)
postings.description:
À PROPOS D'ISEMBARD

Isembard construit un réseau d'usines de haute performance pour les industries critiques. Nous combinons machines-outils de pointe, robotique et notre propre logiciel, MasonOS, pour fabriquer des pièces de précision destinées à l'aéronautique, la défense, l'énergie et les technologies de rupture, avec des usines au Royaume-Uni, aux États-Unis, en Allemagne et en France. Notre mission : forger l'accélération industrielle.


VOUS NE TROUVEZ PAS LE POSTE QUI VOUS CORRESPOND ?

Nous rencontrons souvent des personnes formidables avant d'avoir le bon poste à leur proposer. Si vous voulez contribuer à construire Isembard en France et qu'aucune de nos offres actuelles ne vous correspond, postulez ici et dites-nous sur quoi vous aimeriez travailler.

Nous lisons toutes les candidatures. Dès qu'un poste correspondant à votre expérience s'ouvre, nous vous recontactons.


LES PROFILS QUE NOUS AIMERIONS RENCONTRER

 - Usineurs, programmeurs, contrôleurs et ingénieurs ayant déjà fabriqué des pièces de précision.

 - Profils logiciel, robotique et data qui veulent voir leur travail tourner dans un vrai atelier.

 - Profils opérations, supply chain, commerce et finance prêts à aider un industriel en forte croissance à changer d'échelle.


COMMENT POSTULER

 - Téléchargez votre CV et ajoutez votre profil LinkedIn si vous en avez un.

 - Indiquez-nous le domaine qui vous intéresse.

 - Quelques lignes sur votre intérêt pour Isembard suffisent. Pas besoin de lettre de motivation.

Lieu : Sur site, dans notre usine de Paris.

Isembard s'engage pour l'égalité des chances. Les candidatures en français ou en anglais sont les bienvenues.
